rule: Only lines below with cls P are shown as fact. Anything else in the room is KONA.m interpretation and is labelled I in its card. No official logo, mark, name styling or photography is used.

start.line: The race starts with a jump from a car ferry into the Hardangerfjord, then a swim to land at Eidfjord.

water.line: Race-day water has been between 55 °F and 62 °F (about 13–17 °C) in recent years.

bike.line: Bike 180 km. The first 40 km climb, to about 1,200 m above sea level.

bike_climbing.line: Total bike climbing is reported differently by different sources (from about 3,000 m to more than 10,000 ft); the room does not pick one number.

t2.line: Transition 2 is at Austbygde, about 190 m above sea level.

run.line: Run 42.2 km. Roughly the first 25 km are flat, to Rjukan; the rest climbs toward Gaustatoppen.

summit.line: Gaustatoppen stands about 1,880 m above sea level.

cut.line: The first 160 athletes to reach the 37 km point are sent up the mountain; the rest finish the same distance on a lower course.

shirts.line: Summit finishers receive a black finisher top; finishers on the lower course receive a white one.

crew.line: Athletes must bring their own support crew; the crew also goes up the final climb with them.

backpack.line: On the final climb athletes carry a backpack with emergency food and clothing.

field.line: First held in 2003 with 21 starters; today about 250–300 athletes start.

profile.rule: Anchor points are the sourced values above. The line between anchors, the plateau shape and the horizontal spacing are KONA.m interpretation, not GPS data, and not to scale.
